author: Jotagarsis
quote: I’d like to say quite honestly that this game isn’t what it seems. I’ve played it for about 40 hours and, whilst the graphics do look good, it suffers from frame rate drops below 30 FPS. The story is really poor; the characters lack charisma, and I’ve encountered loads of bugs – you can’t always save the game manually. Honestly, does this game deserve this rating? I don’t think so. I’m disappointed after waiting so long for it. It would be a real shame if it won Game of the Year.

author: Jotagarsis
quote: I think people are being way too harsh on this game. Don't pay too much attention to the extremely low scores it has received. The studio is Insomniac, and sure, there are some things that could be improved. But it's a very fun game and, graphically, it looks like one of the best games on **** narrative is also one of its strongest points. Maybe the combat could be better, but it took me around 20 hours to complete, and I can honestly say it's an excellent ****'s not as polished and well-rounded as the Spider-Man games, but it is definitely a very good game.

author: Jotagarsis
quote: The best fighting game in recent years – it looks and feels incredible. The story mode, with its comic-book style and all the Marvel characters, is brilliant. If you fancy a fighting game, this is the one for you.

author: Jotagarsis
quote: Team Ninja has come up with a great game, it's the best in the series. The open world suits it perfectly, and being able to switch between Samurai and Ninja makes for super dynamic combat. I'm almost finished and have played for about 70 hours. It looks great on my PS5 PRO. It's not graphically stunning, but that doesn't take away from it being one of the games of the year. It's a little difficult at first to get to grips with all the components you're given, but then the game becomes enjoyable and a lot of fun.Translated with **** (free version)

author: Jotagarsis
quote: What can I say about this game? I've played it 100% on my channel, and I can tell you that it's on par with Metroid 3, which is one of the worst Metroid games. The desert part is awful, the ending is just painful. After eight years of showing it, they go and do this? I even think the score of 8 is too high. Anyway, Metroid fans surely won't dare to tell the truth.

author: Jotagarsis
quote: The game for my opinion is one of the best Souls you can find along with Lies of P. It's much better than Lords of the Fallen, Ai limit... but not better than Khazan. The level design is as top notch as you can find in a Souls, it's like Dark Souls 1 but improved. In terms of performance I've tested it on both the PS5 Pro and a PC that is 2 years old, I'll take the PRO. If you like Souls don't hesitate to try it, it's a marvel. The score is low because the press has a bad opinion about games from the East, see Wukong, Stellar Blade, Lies of P...Translated with **** (free version)

author: Jotagarsis
quote: Hello everyone, after playing this Obsidian game I had high hopes for it. People who know me I have a channel where I upload live streams know that I have always liked Obsidian games. But I have to say that this is by far the worst game, it does not have a story that hooks you, the graphics could be improved, you do not interact with anything in the scenario is all very cardboard stone, the gameplay becomes very repetitive ... In short another game of an Xbox studio that does not go well, and there are many. This is getting worse.

author: Jotagarsis
quote: I have played on a very high-end PC and had a lot of problems with the game. I have had several bugs that have made the game experience was not satisfactory, we know that Bethesda is a studio that does not optimize games well. I was excited about the game but I felt like I was playing a Skyrim mixed with FallOut in space. Very empty planets, NPCs that left a lot to be desired. In short, it's a game that I don't recommend
